typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FlatFileConnectionManager_AlwaysCheckForRowDelimiters as boolean ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBERID as string,
		STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(CurrentDateTime = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_MEMBERID as string,
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_CREATEDATETIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_MEMBERID = MEMBERID,
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_CREATEDATETIME = CurrentDateTime,
		CAREGUIDE_OUTREACHED_STAGING_STATUS = STATUS)) ~> OLEDBDestination
